phase: Matched production-temperature Stage1 raw format and neutrality transfer. Exact previously frozen 96 citizen/case/arm contexts and four seeds; no policy effect estimate.
design: Identical frozen persona, synthetic Day0 state and date within each pair. Fiscal arms share environment. Distancing arms differ only in explicitly registered restrictions, not disease background. Read-only Neo4j; no rollout or database reset.
initial_state: 39 times daily_wd cash; mood=0.5, fatigue=0.3, energy=0.7, satisfaction=0.6; no prior memories or appointments. These are simulation initial conditions, not observed personal history.
cashback_seed: Monthly eligible spend seeded as daily weighted anchor * 0.268 * (day_of_month - 1), identically in off/on arms. Policy facts use experiment date as counterfactual start.
attribution_rule: In fiscal off arms flag trigger=policy AND reasoning mentioning P012/P013/P014/cashback/coupon/voucher/grant/local voucher. Environmental regulation attribution is allowed. This is a conservative screening flag, not a validated hallucination classifier; manually inspect flagged text before interpretation.
contract_checks: valid time and strictly increasing >=20 minute spacing
decision: v53 must remove policy-specific merchant and grant defaults in its rendered shared body, produce all 384 registered raw responses, reach at least 95% strict format validity, show no increase in strict format failures versus v51, have zero request failures and zero false fiscal policy attributions in off arms. Inspect all raw failures; this technical gate is not external effect validation.
inference: Development-context Stage1 raw response comparison at temperature 0.7 only. No claim about Stage2 purchase realization, external direction or magnitude, independent holdout, or optimal prompt.
holdout: P015 is prohibited from rerun and is not a fresh holdout. This experiment uses only previously known development contexts.
magnitude_future: Use simultaneous independent on/off rollouts, same dates and initial snapshots, independent run replicates. Report effect and interval; 0.5-2.0 empirical magnitude only when population, outcome definition, denominator and horizon match. Otherwise mark not comparable.
stop_rule: Run all 768 calls exactly once, preserve raw responses, context and system hashes, request errors, and usage. Do not stop early on significance or silently retry failed cells.
power: The paired test is interpreted with 384 cells and its observed discordance. Lack of significance is not evidence of equivalence.
predicted: Policy-neutral wording should prevent unsupported merchant-scope and grant-style assumptions; direction and magnitude of policy effects are deliberately unspecified.
not_changed: Model, 96 frozen contexts, 12 personas, four cases, dates, two arms, four seeds, max_tokens=2200, and raw contract checks are inherited exactly from validation_v51_v52. Candidate set and temperature are the only execution changes.
